# A Gantt milestone draws as a diamond, with an example of a plan's gates

## Context

#21346 asks ten Gantt demonstrations; `dev` `78013b10fc` shows eight. Its body holds "Gantt milestones" back as an engine gap. The operator's direction of 22 Nov opens the last day before the cut for more demos, so the gap and its example become one leaf: this is the ninth Gantt card.

## The Problem

A buyer of a Gantt chart looks for milestones first: the gates of a plan, drawn as diamonds on a date. In the engine a milestone is a bar. `src/gantt/Column.mjs:21` adds `neo-gantt-bar-milestone`, and `resources/css/src/gantt/Container.css:149` gives that class a fill, a border and `border-radius: 999px`. With zero duration (`src/gantt/Container.mjs:865`) it draws as a sliver, which the source check of 18 Nov measured as "a flagged bar 6 px wide". No example makes milestones its subject; `examples/gantt/basic` has one.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/gantt/TaskModel.mjs` carries the `milestone` field; `Container.mjs:865-913` already treats a milestone as zero duration in drag, resize and working-time maths.
- The bar's node is built in `src/gantt/Column.mjs`; links attach through `src/gantt/DependencyLayer.mjs`.
- Themes for the planning families exist for Neo Dark, Neo Light and Cyberpunk (#20932).

## The Fix

A milestone draws as a diamond centred on its date, at the row's height, with its name beside it, in all three themes. Dependency links start and end at the diamond's points. It stays movable by drag and cannot be resized. Then one new example, `examples/gantt/milestones`: a product launch with five or six gates between its phases; moving a task before a gate moves the gate with it (the cascade exists). One line on the first frame says what to try.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A task with `milestone: true` draws as a diamond centred on its date, with a readable label, in Neo Dark, Neo Light and Cyberpunk.
- [ ] Links into and out of a milestone meet the diamond.
- [ ] A milestone moves by drag and offers no resize handle; the existing Gantt unit specs pass, and one spec covers the milestone's node.
- [ ] The example opens on a plan whose gates are visible at rest, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, with no console error.
- [ ] Its record is the ninth card in Gantt, with a cover from its first frame (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame in all three themes and a frame after the named move, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

Baselines, a critical path, constraints on a milestone's date. The task tree (#21346's other open Gantt row).

## Avoided Traps

- **A rotated square in CSS alone.** A rotated bar rotates its label and its hit area with it; the diamond is its own node or shape.
